Red 0 of 2, behavioural, reads no repository file. The defect is in the product, not the test: promotion-preview-render.ts derives the airline tenant's key by matching /sky\s?harbor/i against CANONICAL_TENANTS display names, and that tenant's display name was changed to a neutral demo label, so no name matches and the derived key is the empty string. The tenant key skyharbor-air is still declared. buildPreviewData therefore counts zero rows into the tenant-specific section for every input, which is the first failure (expected 2, received 0). Repair: resolve the key from the declared key, never from a display name. The second failure expects the old display name in the rendered heading; the heading now prints the neutral label on purpose, so that assertion is updated in the same repair.

repaired.what: promotion-preview-render.ts now resolves the airline demo tenant by its declared key in CANONICAL_TENANTS and throws at load when that key is no longer declared, instead of matching a display name and falling back to the empty string. The test's heading assertion now expects the neutral demo label the renderer prints on purpose, plus the row count under it; a third case proves a different tenant's row is not counted into the section.
